query: Issue #60 adds grdr-export (layer 3, internal, privilege none). Create the crate.
The policy module now has a second consumer, the in-browser policy check. Split it out of grdr-core into its own crate.
run cargo xtask new-crate grdr-redact --layer 1 --privilege none --surface internal and finish the setup around it
Add the new layer 4 program grdr-uplink for the fleet squad's item, with its metadata and test layout.
We need a grdr-conformance tool crate for the adapter conformance suite. Scaffold it so archlint accepts it.
How do I set up [package.metadata.grdr] and the crate AGENTS.md for a new grdr-bus-log adapter crate?
Make a new crate grdr-judge-local for the first judge back end, behind the JudgeBackend trait.
The detect module needs a different licence because of the bundled rule engine. Move it into its own workspace crate.
Create grdr-mcp-proto as the parsing half of grdr-mcp, layer 1, public surface.
I need a new workspace member for the S-15 benchmark harness, a tool crate. What's the right way to add it in this repo?
Add a module compile::interest inside grdr-core for interest sets; it has one consumer.
Update the Invariants section of crates/grdr-wire/AGENTS.md with the finding from last week's review.
Add serde_json as a dependency of grdr-engine for the new parser.
Bump rust-toolchain.toml to 1.100.1 now that it is fourteen days old.
Add a same-layer edge from grdr-wire to grdr-model in architecture.toml.
Delete the grdr-fastpath-ffi crate, nothing calls it any more.
Publish grdr-proto 0.1.0 to crates.io.
Create a new pnpm package under web/ for the DTCG design tokens.
Write the specification for the sink interface of the grdr-export crate, including failure modes.
Fix the clippy error ARCH-003 reports in grdr-model: it calls SystemTime::now.
